script.text: Hello. This is the Cambridge Assessment English Flyers Listening Test.
Part 1. Listen and look. There is one example.
Look at this picture of the new shopping centre in my town.
It looks nice, but they haven't finished it yet, I think. There's a man who's going to do some work.
The man who's wearing a baseball cap?
Yes.
That's Richard. He's a painter and he lives on our street.
Can you see the line? This is an example. Now you listen and draw lines.
Can you see the woman who's holding the envelopes? That's my Aunt Sarah.
Does she work there?
Yes she does. Her office is on the fifth floor.
Ah... so she's going to take the elevator to her office?
That's right. There are too many stairs!
Do you know that man in the uniform?
The man who's cooking something?
No, not him... the other one.
Oh OK... you mean the firefighter?
Yes. He's waving to someone.
His name's Oliver. He's a friend of my dad's.
Look at that woman's scarf. It's very bright!
That's Emma... my friend's mom. She always wears clothes like that.
Does she? I think she's just bought a newspaper.
Perhaps... she goes to the shopping centre every day to buy something or have a coffee.
OK. So, she doesn't work there?
No, she doesn't.
Another one of my dad's friends is there too.
Is he the man who's wearing the shirt and striped tie?
No. He's going into that shop... look.
Oh yes... the man in the sweater?
That's right. His name's William.
He looks nice.
Do you see the woman who's reading the magazine?
Yes. What's her name?
That's Helen. She's my mom's best friend.
Her hair's the same as your mom's... long and straight.
I know!
Now listen to Part 1 again.
[The recording is repeated.]
That is the end of Part 1.

parts.title: Listen and write

items.pre: Meal on first evening: rice and

script.text: Part 2. Listen and look. There is one example.
OK, children. I want to tell you about our school camping trip next Monday.
I love camping! Can I ask a question, please?
Yes, of course, Katy.
Where are we going to stay?
Well, this year we're going to stay in the desert for two nights.
Oh wow! That's so cool!
Can you see the answer? Now you listen and write.
Where will we camp?
We won't be far from the famous Silver Pyramid, sorry I mean the Gold Pyramid. You can actually see it from our camping place.
Oh I've heard about that. My dad said it's amazing!
It is! I've seen it several times.
What do we need to take with us for the camping trip?
Well, just the usual things really... nothing special. The school will bring a hat for everyone because it'll be very hot there. And you mustn't forget to put your sunglasses in your bag.
OK. What will we do on the first day?

We'll learn about the life of the people who live there... their food, their work, their homes. We'll also see some wild horses that live there. We can't ride those but you can all go for a ride on camels.
Cool! I've never done that before. So what are we going to eat?
Well, you're going to eat something very nice on the first night. We'll cook it on the fire... meatballs and rice.
That sounds fantastic! My mum often makes that. Who's going to come with us on the trip?
Well, I'll be there. And Miss Birch, the new science teacher, will come too.
Erm, I don't know her. How do you spell her name?
It's B-I-R-C-H. You'll like her. She's very kind.
OK. I can't wait!
Now listen to Part 2 again.
[The recording is repeated.]
That is the end of Part 2.

script.text: Part 3. Listen and look. There is one example. Where did Aunt Betty buy each of these things in her cupboard?
I like your belt, Aunt Betty. Where did you get it?
I bought that on holiday. We visited a market and they had lots of nice things there.
Was it expensive?
No. It was actually very cheap!
Can you see the letter B? Now you listen and write a letter in each box.
What about this necklace? Did you buy that on holiday, too?
Yes, I did. I got it on the day that we left home.
Oh? So, did you get it when you were waiting at the airport?
That's right!
This crown's really cool! You worked as an actor, didn't you? Did you buy it at a shop in the theatre?
Well, I wore it when I was acting. I played a queen!
Wow! I'm sure you were great!
Thanks. I loved doing it. I found it in a small shop at the museum in town one day when I was there with my friend. She bought one, too.
Is she also an actor?
Yes, she is.
I've worn these gloves a lot.
They're nice, but they look a bit old now.
Well, I've had them for ten years. I always wore them when I was travelling to work.
Do you remember where you bought them?
Let me think. Oh yes... in the shop at the castle.
Oh I know. They have some really cool things there!
This ring's great. Was it a present?
No, I bought it when I was on holiday with your uncle. There was one just like it in the shop at our hotel.
So did you decide to buy it then?
No, we left the shop and walked to the beach and guess what?
What?
I found the same one there but it was much cheaper!
So you got that one.
That's right!
Mom has an umbrella that looks like this. Did you go shopping together?
I don't think so, no. I bought this when I was shopping at the market one day...
OK.
No, wait a minute... I remember now... I got it at the shop at the train station on my way to the city because it started to rain!
I like the colours. It's pretty!
I love it, too. It's my favourite one!
Now listen to Part 3 again.
[The recording is repeated.]
That is the end of Part 3.

script.text: Part 4. Listen and look. There is one example. How did Michael get to the hotel?
Did you have a nice holiday, Michael?
Yeah, it was fantastic! Our hotel was in the centre of town.
Did you go there by car?
Actually, we took a boat! It was fun.
Oh I see, and then did you use the bus when you were there?
Yes, we did.
Can you see the tick? Now you listen and tick the box.
1  What did Michael have in his hotel room?
What was your room like?
It was really big. It had a balcony and there was a great TV on the wall.
That sounds nice.
There was a tablet there, too, for us to use.
What a good idea! And you can use that as a clock when you want to know the time.
That's right.
2  Who stayed in Michael's room?
Who stayed in your room with you?
I wanted my brother to stay with me, but he wanted his own room.
Well, he's older than you so that's OK.
Yeah, I know. Dad was in my room and my baby sister stayed with my mum.
I hope she didn't cry too much!
She did! She cries a lot!
3  What was the weather like on Friday?
Last Friday I saw something amazing!
Oh? What was that?
Well, it was windy in the morning but then it rained a lot and there was the most beautiful rainbow I've ever seen in the sky.
Wow! You're lucky! We just had a lot of fog here.
I know. My friend told me that, too.
4  Which food did Michael eat every day for breakfast?
Was the food nice?
Yes, it was wonderful. Everyone's favourite meal was breakfast.
Why was that?
They had some really nice yoghurt. Dad ate that. And Mum had bread and eggs for breakfast.
Did you have the same?
I had the honey. It was really delicious so I had that with bread every morning.
5  What did Michael lose?
You didn't send me a postcard, Michael.
I got you one and I wanted to send it to you.
So what happened?
Well, when I was walking to the post office with my brother, he dropped his phone and keys.
Oh no!
Yes, and while I was picking them up for him, it fell out of my pocket into the river. Sorry...
Now listen to Part 4 again.
[The recording is repeated.]
That is the end of Part 4.

script.text: Hello. This is the Cambridge Assessment English Flyers Listening Test.
Part 1 Listen and look. There is one example.
I took this photo when we went camping last weekend, Mr Whistle.
It looks fun! Do you know all these people?
Yes, I do. They're my friends. The girl who's running is Sophia.
I like her baseball cap.
She has lots of them. She's wearing the blue one — that's her favourite.
Can you see the line? This is an example. Now you listen and draw lines.
And who's that boy who's sitting by the fire?
The boy? Oh, that's David. This was his first time that he went camping.
Did he play that drum a lot?
Yes, he was very noisy, but he was funny.
Someone near the tent looks unhappy about the noise!
The girl in the pyjamas? Yes, that's Katy. She wanted to stay in bed and sleep.
Why? Was she tired?
Yes, because she stayed up late the night before to see the stars.
There are two boys who are going into the cave. I think I know one of those boys.
Do you mean the one with the rucksack?
No, not him. The boy with the torch.
That's George. He lives in my street.
Oh, yes. I do know him.
Is your friend Helen here?
Yes, she's lying down near the pond.
Is she the one who's giving food to the swan?
No, she's got her elbows on a rock. She's really friendly.
Have you ever met my friend Betty?
I don't think so. Is she here?
Yes, she's cooking burgers at the fire.
Has she got curly hair?
Yes, that's her. She actually burnt our food a bit! But we didn't mind.
Now listen to Part 1 again.
[The recording is repeated.]
That is the end of Part 1.

script.text: Part 2 Listen and look. There is one example.
Hi, Grandma.
Hi, William. How are you?
Great. I went to the cycling club after school today.
Do you go every week?
Yes, it's on Mondays from 3 until 5 o'clock.
Can you see the answer? Now you listen and write.
Do any of your classmates go to the club, too?
One of them does. He was in the club before me and invited me to join.
Do I know him?
Yes, it's Frank.
And what do you learn at the cycling club?
A lot!
Do you learn about safe cycling?
Sometimes, but today we learnt about fixing bikes.
So, can you repair everything?
No problem!
Fantastic!.. Does your club go cycling on the roads?
No. We go to a park, where we cycle on paths.
I see. That sounds great.
Yes. It's amazing there.
Does the club have bikes you can use?
No, it doesn't, actually. You have to bring a bike.
Do you have to wear a special jacket?
We can if we want, but everyone has to put on a helmet.
That's very important... What else do you do at the club?
Well, at the end of the year we have a party with races. It's really fun.
Have you ever won?
Yes, once. I love cycling!
Now listen to Part 2 again.
[The recording is repeated.]
That is the end of Part 2.

script.text: Part 3 Listen and look. There is one example. Where did Uncle Harry take each of these photos?
Hi, Uncle Harry, did you have a good trip?
Yes I did, Emma.
Did you fly there?
Yes, and then I took a train to the city. But I was tired and I went to sleep!
Oh dear! Did you wake up at the right time?
Yes, I was lucky! When I woke up, I saw these beautiful flowers in the railway station. I was surprised, so I took a photo.
Can you see the letter F? Now you listen and write a letter in each box.
Where did you take this photo?
Oh, that was in my hotel room.
But why did you take a picture of a shelf?
I need one for my magazines at home, and I liked this one, so I took a picture of it.
I like it, too. I'd like one of those in my bedroom.
One day I went to the theatre and saw a very good concert.
Did you go there in this taxi?
No, I travelled in that when I went to a chocolate factory the next day.
Why did you take this picture?
Well, the driver was very friendly.
You took a picture of a painting! Did you visit an art museum?
That's actually a funny story. At the hotel, I dropped something heavy on my toe! I thought it was broken!
Oh no! Did you go to the hospital?
Yes, and that's where I saw this. Looking at something so lovely made me feel a little better.
Are you OK now?
Oh yes. Fine. Silly me!
I like this photo of a flag. Where did you take it?
I went to a castle which had a lot of flags. But I took this on a different day, in front of a stadium. A lot of people were going in. I think there was something happening inside.
I can see the colours really well.
And where did you take this picture, Uncle Harry?
Well, I went to a very nice village. There was a museum there, and I really enjoyed visiting that.
Was this special gate outside?
Yes. It was painted gold and it looked beautiful in the sun.
Now listen to Part 3 again.
[The recording is repeated.]
That is the end of Part 3.

parts.exampleText: What does Mrs Silver design in her job? = A (ví dụ)

script.text: Part 4 Listen and look. There is one example. What does Mrs Silver design in her job?
Hi, Mrs Silver. For my homework, I have to ask a grown-up about their job. Can I ask you?
Of course!
I know you're an engineer, but what do you design? Is it motorways?
No, bridges. In the future I'd like to design skyscrapers because they're very exciting.
Wow!
Can you see the tick? Now you listen and tick the box.
1 What was Mrs Silver's favourite subject at school?
When did you decide to be an engineer, Mrs Silver?
At school.
You design things, so my guess is that your favourite subject was... art!
I liked that, a lot, but I enjoyed geography the most.
Did your friends like it, too?
No. They all preferred science.
2 Who else in Mrs Silver's family works as an engineer?
I'm not the only engineer in my family.
Oh really? Is your husband an engineer?
No. But my sister is. She's just a few years older than I am.
And my older brother is studying to be an engineer. He wants to design robots.
3 What time does Mrs Silver start work?
Mrs Silver, do you start work early in the morning?
Well, I always get to my office at 8:00, but sometimes our meetings don't start until 8:30.
And when do you leave the house?
Around 7:30, after taking the dog for a walk.
4 What is Mrs Silver going to do tomorrow?
Do you have lots of meetings, Mrs Silver?
Yes, I do. When we build new bridges and improve old ones, there's a lot to talk about! But not tomorrow.
Why not?
I'm going to teach a class at the university, which I really enjoy. I went to the library to prepare for it last week.
5 Which bridge is Mrs Silver working on now?
I saw that old bridge in the forest. The one that's made of wood. It's lovely now that you've repaired it.
Thank you, I agree! I also enjoyed working on the bridge over the motorway.
What are you working on now?
A new bridge. It'll be easier for people to get to the island.
That sounds brilliant! Thanks for helping me with my homework.
No problem!
Now listen to Part 4 again.
[The recording is repeated.]
That is the end of Part 4.

script.text: Hello. This is the Cambridge Assessment English Flyers Listening Test.
Part 1 Listen and look. There is one example.
This is an interesting photo.
Thanks. I took it last week. My uncle David works at the airport and I went to work with him one day.
Is your uncle in the photo?
Yes. Look. He's there in a baseball cap. He's a mechanic and he had to fix a problem with a machine.
Can you see the line? This is an example. Now you listen and draw lines.
Do you know something amazing? I know a lot of the people in this photo?
Really?
Yes. Can you see my friend Harry? He's a hockey player and he was coming back from a trip with his team.
The boy in the striped T-shirt?
Yes, that's right.
Do you know that child who's carrying a backpack?
Is it orange?
No, not that one. The one that I mean has got some flowers in it.
Oh, that's George. Those were a present for his grandma.
Why is that girl carrying a cushion?
The girl who's wearing sunglasses?
Yes.
That's my friend's little sister Katy. She takes that everywhere.
That's a good idea. Then she can sleep on it on the plane.
Yes, she can.
Are any more of your friends in this photo?
Yes. Can you see the girl with really curly hair?
Is she meeting her mom?
That's right. Her name's Sophia. Her mom had to visit her family in another country and she was away for a long time.
Was your friend pleased to see her?
Yes, very.
There's one more person that I know in the photo.
Which one?
Her name's Sarah. She lives in our street. She has an important job in business and she travels a lot.

Well, my friend's parents hid presents for us in different places in the house. We had to find them.

Six — one for each of us. My present was a bracelet and do you know where I found it?
Where?
On a shelf in the bathroom!
Can you see the letter G? Now you listen and write a letter in each box.
My friend Daisy got a really nice present.
What was that?
Well, she loves dressing up, so her present was a pretty necklace. It was made of glass.

That's right.

script.text: Hello. This is the Cambridge Assessment English A2 Flyers Listening Test.
Part 1 Listen and look. There is one example.

Wow!

What's her name?
Sophia.

Oh! Well, it's good that he's wearing a helmet.
Yes. They didn't let us cycle anywhere without one.
Well, that's important . . . He's got a nice bike!
Yes!
And can you see Emma?

Not that afternoon, but the next day she made some fantastic pancakes!
Great!

Which one's she? The girl on the high rock?

That new factory in Long Road.
Who took you there?
Our science teacher. They're making some really amazing computers there.
Can you buy them in the shops?
No, they're only for big businesses.
What about the history teacher?
We went out with her last Thursday.
Did you go to the museum?
My mum asked me that! No, we didn't. We went to the hotel in the High Street.
Really? Why?
Because they built it three hundred years ago. A lot of famous people stayed there. You can still see some of the things that they forgot to take home with them!
My favourite day was with our maths teacher.
Did you go to the bank and count the money?
(laughs) No, we didn't. We went to the castle.
Really? What did you do there?
We looked at things like the clothes and the beds of the people that lived there. We had to decide if people today are taller. We're much bigger!
You went to a lot of places.
Yes. Guess where we went with the geography teacher.
Er . . . the airport?
Yes. We're learning about all the countries in the world. So we went to see where you can travel to from there.
Who's your favourite teacher?
Mr Black. He teaches us art.
And I think he took you to the museum to see some paintings!
Wrong again! There's a big restaurant in the square. Some artists are showing their paintings there this week. So we went there.
Were they good?
Yes, very. And the cake that he bought for us there was very good, too!
Now listen to Part 3 again.
[The recording is repeated.]
That is the end of Part 3.

parts.title: Listen and tick the box
parts.vi: Nghe và chọn tranh đúng (A, B hoặc C). Có 1 ví dụ: What did Uncle Robert do with his friends last night? – A (xem bóng đá trên tivi).

items.q: 1  Where should Katy put the clean glasses?
2  What did Uncle Robert and his friends eat?
3  Who is the best player in the football team?
4  Which sport is Uncle Robert best at?
5  What does Uncle Robert want to show Katy later?

parts.exampleText: What did Uncle Robert do with his friends last night? = A (ví dụ)

script.text: Part 4 Listen and look. There is one example. What did Uncle Robert do with his friends last night?
Uncle Robert! Why is your living room so untidy?
My friends came round yesterday evening.
For a party?
No. They came to watch a football game.
Do they always make the house untidy like this?
No. Last week they came and played computer games and everything was fine.
Can you see the tick? Now you listen and tick the box.
1 Where should Katy put the clean glasses?
Can I help you to tidy the living room, Uncle Robert?
Yes please, Katy.
OK. Where shall I put these clean glasses? In the kitchen cupboard?
They're not mine. I have to give them back to my friend.
Shall I put them in the hall?
Put them by the oven. I don't want anyone to fall over them.
2 What did Uncle Robert and his friends eat?
Did you and your friends eat pizza last night?
We just had pasta because it's quick and easy to cook.
I love that too. What's your favourite food?
Oh, meat and vegetables, I think.
3 Who is the best player in the football team?
Who won the game last night?
My team!
Great. Who's the best player? That one with long hair? He always wears orange shoes.
Not now. Their new player's the best. He wears black shoes.
Has he got blond, curly hair?
Well, it is curly but it's dark.
4 Which sport is Uncle Robert best at?
Are you good at football, Uncle Robert?
I was, but I do most of my sports in the mountains now.
So, what are you best at?
Well, when I first went there, I always skied. But I won a snowboarding competition last winter, so I think I'm best at that now.
5 What does Uncle Robert want to show Katy later?
Did you get a prize for winning the competition?
Yes, but I didn't get a cup. Just a delicious dinner. You can see me eating it in this photo.
Great.
But I do have a video of me winning the race. Shall I show it to you?
OK. But shall we do that later? Let's finish tidying first.
You're right! No more chatting!
Now listen to Part 4 again.
[The recording is repeated.]
That is the end of Part 4.

parts.title: Listen and colour and write
parts.vi: Nghe và tô màu / viết chữ vào tranh. Có 1 ví dụ (phi hành gia mặc đồ màu vàng).

items.text: Colour the head of the alien with the cup of tea – green (tô cái đầu của người ngoài hành tinh đang cầm tách trà màu xanh lá)
Write ROCKET above 'stop' on the board (viết ROCKET phía trên chữ 'stop' trên tấm biển)
Colour the planet with holes in it – red (tô hành tinh có nhiều lỗ màu đỏ)
Colour the star on the right, with the friendly face – purple (tô ngôi sao bên phải có khuôn mặt thân thiện màu tím)
Write RAINBOW on the side of the spaceship (viết RAINBOW lên thân tàu vũ trụ)

keyText: 1 Colour the head of the alien with the cup of tea – green
2 Write ROCKET above 'stop' on the board
3 Colour the planet with holes in it – red
4 Colour the star on the right, with the friendly face – purple
5 Write RAINBOW on the side of the spaceship
answerText: 1 Colour the head of the alien with the cup of tea – green
2 Write ROCKET above 'stop' on the board
3 Colour the planet with holes in it – red
4 Colour the star on the right, with the friendly face – purple
5 Write RAINBOW on the side of the spaceship

script.text: Part 5 Listen and look at the picture. There is one example.
What's that picture, William?
It's cool, isn't it? It's from a really funny story that I'm reading about space.
But it's just in black and white. Do you want to colour it?
That's a good idea.
OK. Let's start with the astronaut then. He's just flying around.
Right. I'm going to make his clothes yellow.
Yes. Do that now.
Can you see the astronaut's yellow clothes? This is an example. Now you listen and colour and write.
What shall I colour next?
How about an alien?
Which one? The one with some tea?
Yes, OK. I didn't know that aliens drink from cups.
They do in this story!
It sounds great! OK. Colour his head green.
That's a good colour for him, I think!
Shall I write something now?
Yes. Can you see that board with 'stop' on it?
Shall I write ROCKET on it?
Excellent. Do you know how to spell that?
Yes, thanks.
The planets look interesting.
Yes, I'm going to colour one of them red.
Which one? The one with rings round it?
No, the other one. It's got lots of holes in it.
Right. Would you like to visit that one?
Yes, I would! I'm colouring it now.
What about colouring a star now? You could make it purple.
OK. I'm going to do the one on the left.
But the one on the right has a more friendly face.
Yes, it does. I'll colour that one.
And some more writing now, I think.
Yes. Why don't you write a name on that spaceship?
OK. What shall I write?
Well, it's in the sky. Can you think of another word about the sky?
RAINBOW?
Yes, great idea. Let's call it that.
I'm writing that word now.
That's a great picture, William. You've really improved it!
Now listen to Part 5 again.
[The recording is repeated.]
That is the end of the A2 Flyers Listening Test.

parts.title: Listen and draw lines
parts.vi: Nghe và nối tên với đúng người trong tranh. Có 1 ví dụ (Frank đã nối sẵn).

items.name: Sophia
items.text: Sophia và cô bé đang trượt băng, quàng khăn sọc

items.name: George
items.text: George và cậu bé đeo găng tay xanh, đang làm thân người tuyết

items.name: Harry
items.text: Harry và cậu bé đi ủng lông, đang kéo xe trượt

items.name: Emma
items.text: Emma và cô bé đang trượt nhanh xuống dốc, ngồi trên chiếc đệm hồng

items.name: Katy
items.text: Katy và cô bé nằm trên mặt đất, chỉ còn một chiếc ván trượt

keyText: Lines should be drawn between:
1 Sophia and the girl ice skating, wearing a striped scarf
2 George and the boy wearing blue gloves, making the body of a snowman
3 Harry and the boy pulling a sledge, wearing furry boots
4 Emma and the girl going fast downhill, sitting on a pink cushion
5 Katy and the girl lying on the ground, wearing one ski

script.text: Hello. This is the Cambridge Assessment English A2 Flyers Listening Test.
Part 1 Listen and look. There is one example.
What a great picture!
Thank you, Mr Little! We had such a lot of fun on the mountain on Saturday. Look at my friend Frank!
The boy who's snowboarding?
With the yellow helmet. That's right! He's amazing!
Can you see the line? This is an example. Now you listen and draw lines.
Do you know the names of everyone in this picture?
I know most of them. That girl is called Sophia.
The girl on the ice with a striped scarf around her neck?
In front of the penguins. Yes!
How many times did she fall over?
(laughs) I can't remember!
And that boy, the one who's making another snowman . . . his name's George.
Do you mean the one who's touching the snowman's face?
No, the boy who's wearing blue gloves. He's only made the snowman's body. He hasn't finished it yet.
Right! OK.
And there's Harry. He's really kind.
Which person are you talking about now?
That boy! The one who's pulling the girl on the sledge.
Do you mean the boy in the furry boots?
Yes! I'd like some like that.
Me too!
And who's that? She's going so fast down the hill!
That's Emma. She's really brave. She isn't afraid of anything!
Oh! Why is she sitting on a pink cushion?
I don't know. I'll ask her tomorrow.
I think I know that girl.
The one in the green jacket?
Not her. The girl who's fallen over. She's only wearing one ski now. I hope she was OK. Her name's Katy, isn't it?
Yes! How do you know her?
She sometimes plays chess with my daughter.
Oh!
Now listen to Part 1 again.
[The recording is repeated.]
That is the end of Part 1.

parts.title: Listen and write
parts.vi: Nghe và viết từ/cụm từ còn thiếu (Summer festival). Có 1 ví dụ: 15th July.

script.text: Part 2 Listen and look. There is one example.
Hi, Miss Farmer. Can you tell me more about the summer festival?
Of course. What do you want to know?
The date! I know it's on the fifteenth, but . . .
It'll be on the fifteenth of July. Wait a minute . . . yes, that's right.
Great. I'll text that to my friends.
Brilliant!
Can you see the answer? Now you listen and write.
Do you know which bands will be there yet?
Well, I think the most famous one is called 'The Wolves'. Have you heard any of their music? They're a rock band.
I'm not sure. Do you spell that W–O–L–V–E–S?
That's right. They're really great.
And where is the festival this year?
It'll be in the park.
Which one? The one by the river?
No, that isn't big enough. The one that's next to the stadium.
OK. Thanks. And there's a competition, I think!
Yes, for the best funny hat. The prize is a pair of . . .
Let me guess! Roller skates? I'd love a pair of those!
No! Sunglasses. Some really cool ones.
Wow! Where can I find out some more information?
You can call zero eight eight six one nine. There's a message on that number with everything you need to know about tickets and the times that things start, for example.
Right. Is there anything else that I should tell my parents?
Oh! People shouldn't take any food with them – you can buy some there. But if you and your friends do go, take an umbrella! One year it rained and rained!
We won't forget! Thanks.
Now listen to Part 2 again.
[The recording is repeated.]
That is the end of Part 2.

parts.title: Listen and write a letter in each box
parts.vi: Bố của Holly tìm thấy gì ở mỗi nơi trong nhà? Chọn chữ cái A–H. Có 1 ví dụ: balcony = A.

script.text: Part 3 Listen and look. There is one example. Holly's father is telling Holly about some things he found at home. What did he find in each place?
Hi, Holly! I tidied our home while you were at school today . . . inside and outside. I found something of yours on the balcony.
What, Dad? Was it something that I lost?
Yes, your comb! The one your cousin gave you. Here you are!
Wow! Thanks! I looked everywhere for that.
I know you did!
Can you see the letter A? Now you listen and write a letter in each box.
I'm very pleased that I found this old key.
Oh! Where was that?
On the ground by the gate. I found it when I was cutting the grass.
It's lovely. It's really old, isn't it?
Yes. My grandfather always opened and closed his favourite cupboard with it.
What about my trainers, Dad? Did you find those too? I don't know where they are.
I'm sorry, Holly. No, I didn't.
Oh dear!
But I found this by the swing. It's your lucky bracelet!
But it's broken.
I can fix it. Don't worry.
I'm lucky, too! I found this money.
Where?
On the steps outside. I saw it when I went out to the post office this morning.
And you didn't use it to buy some more stamps?
No!
And look! These were under the cooker. I saw them when I was cleaning the floor.
My little scissors! Excellent! I like to keep those with my glue for when I'm making my model dinosaurs. Perhaps I dropped them . . .
Yes. Perhaps you did. Well, wash and dry them carefully before you take them to your room.
All right.
And last . . . well, you asked me about getting some more stamps. . . . Look!
Four of them. And they're all the same!
Yes. Guess where I found these!
I don't know . . .
In the basement. They were under a box down there. They're very unusual. Come on. Let's try to find a picture of them online. They might be really old.
OK!
Now listen to Part 3 again.
[The recording is repeated.]
That is the end of Part 3.

parts.title: Listen and tick the box
parts.vi: Nghe và chọn tranh đúng (A, B hoặc C). Có 1 ví dụ: Who is Michael going to go to the theatre with? – C (một cô bé).

items.q: 1  How did Michael find out about the special evening at the theatre?
2  How will Michael travel to the theatre?
3  What time does Michael want to arrive at the theatre?
4  What will Michael be most interested in?
5  Where are the theatre tickets?

parts.exampleText: Who is Michael going to go to the theatre with? = C (ví dụ)

script.text: Part 4 Listen and look. There is one example. Who is Michael going to go to the theatre with?
Hello, Mr Roberts. How's your son?
Good morning, Mrs Day. Oh, you mean Michael? He's very excited actually. He's going to go to the theatre tonight. Some actors are going to come and talk about their work.
That sounds interesting. Is he going with you and your wife?
No. He's going with his older sister.
Lovely! But I've forgotten her name . . .
Zoe. She has the same name as her grandmother. She wants to be an actor one day.
Can you see the tick? Now you listen and tick the box.
1 How did Michael find out about the special evening at the theatre?
How did Michael find out about this special evening with the actors?
He read about it in a magazine.
Was that on a website?
No, it wasn't. He phoned all his friends about it! I think quite a lot of them are going to go, too.
2 How will Michael travel to the theatre?
They wanted to travel to the theatre on the train this evening, but the station is too far away.
Well, could they go there on the bus?
That's not easy. I told them to go in a taxi. They were happy about that.
Good! That's the quickest way too, I think.
3 What time does Michael want to arrive at the theatre?
Will Michael have to go before dinner?
No. We'll eat early. He wants to leave home just before seven o'clock.
Oh. So what time will he arrive at the theatre?
It starts at half past seven. Michael says he wants to be there by a quarter past, so they'll have enough time to find their seats.
4 What will Michael be most interested in?
How do actors remember all the things they have to say?
Ha! I don't know, but Michael isn't very interested in hearing about that.
Why not?
I'm not sure. He's much more interested in finding out about building the things you see on the stage.
Well, I'm always interested in the actors' costumes. I make all my clothes!
Do you? Well done!
5 Where are the theatre tickets?
But I've got to go now, Mrs Day. Michael's just sent me a text. He can't find the tickets! He's looked in all his pockets.
Oh dear. I hope he didn't drop them in the street!
No, don't worry. I know where they are. I put them in my diary.
Good. Well, I hope it'll be fun.
I'm sure it will. See you tomorrow. Bye!
Now listen to Part 4 again.
[The recording is repeated.]
That is the end of Part 4.

parts.title: Listen and colour and write
parts.vi: Nghe và tô màu / viết chữ vào tranh. Có 1 ví dụ (lâu đài màu hồng).

2 Write DEEP above 'water'

5 Write CENTRE after 'city'
answerText: 1 Colour the newspaper in the man's hands – purple

script.text: Part 5 Listen and look at the picture. There is one example.
I'd like you to do some colouring and writing here.
Sure! What can I colour first?
How about the castle? The one on the hill. Make it pink, please.
No problem. There!
Great!
Can you see the pink castle? This is an example. Now you listen and colour and write.
Can I colour something purple, next? That's my favourite colour.
All right. Let me think. I know! Colour the newspaper that the older man is holding.
Fine. I'll do that now.
Excellent.
We also need to write something on the board. The one that's on the rock in the middle of the lake.
OK. Above the word 'water'?
Yes. Write DEEP there.
All right. So it'll be difficult for that boy to get his football back?
Yes!
Oh dear. He won't be pleased!
Now some more colouring. Find the colour green and use it to colour one of the swans.
The one that the girl is feeding? It looks very hungry.
No. I meant the other one, actually.
OK. But I've never seen one that colour!
(laughs) I know. It's all right.
Those lights are unusual . . .
Would you like to colour one of them?
I'd prefer to colour the bin by the man who's selling ice cream. It'll be easier!
That's a good idea. What colour? You choose.
I'll make it red. That'll look good.
I agree.
And let's add another word here. Are you good at spelling?
Not always! What should I write?
Can you write CENTRE after the word 'city'?
Oh! On the other board? Yes, I can. There!
Very good. This picture looks a bit more interesting now. Thank you!
You're welcome.
Now listen to Part 5 again.
[The recording is repeated.]
That is the end of the A2 Flyers Listening Test.
